name: Nature-Inspired Chemical Engineering
description: Introduction to the fascinating intersection of biology and chemical engineering. Analyze biological systems from a chemical engineering perspective and apply these insights to innovative solutions to complex chemical engineering challenges. Nature-inspired approach to traditional chemical engineering topics, emerging chemical engineering topics, and mathematical problems. Multiscale, hierarchical systems. Applications to fluid mechanics, fluidization, and fluid-particle systems. Applications to catalysis and hierarchically structured catalysts, materials, reactors, fractals, nano-confinement, separations – membranes.
